title: Pricing · add-ons
description: ServiceWand pricing add-ons block for dynamic capacity and usage products such as building packs and routing token expansions. Static slots remain as the CMS/editor fallback.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only: separate credit/add-on rows. Visual language normalized to ServiceWand lab-ui tokens.
source.decision: Add-ons stay separate from plans and render from Core PIM catalogs when dynamic pricing is enabled; static slots are only the fallback/editor preview.

params.name: Add-ons Eyebrow
params.description: Small uppercase label above the add-ons heading.

params.name: Add-ons Heading
params.description: Main heading for the add-ons section.

params.default: Buy more buildings, routing optimization tokens, and rollout support as operational demand grows.
params.name: Add-ons Lede
params.description: Introductory paragraph for the add-ons section.

params.default: Add-on availability can vary by plan. Final eligibility rules should come from CRM before upload.
params.name: Add-ons Disclaimer
params.description: Small disclaimer shown below the add-on cards.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Enabled
params.description: Opts this block into loading Core PIM add-on catalogs. When false or when loading fails, the static add-on slots remain the rendered fallback/editor preview.

params.name: Pricing API Base
params.description: Core PIM API base path or origin. The shared pricing runtime posts to /public/{organization}/catalog/price-comparison.json.

params.name: Pricing Organization
params.description: Core PIM organization code used in the public catalog URL.

params.name: Pricing Catalog Specs
params.description: Semicolon-separated dynamic catalogs. Format per item: productTypeCode|priceTypeCode|priceAttributeCode|priceAttributeValues|fixtureUrl. The fixtureUrl part stays empty in CMS production.

params.name: Pricing Sort Attribute Code
params.description: Product attribute used to sort add-on products inside each requested catalog before falling back to amount.

params.name: Pricing Currency
params.description: Currency attribute value requested from Core PIM.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Purchase URL
params.description: Shared purchase/contact URL available to dynamic adapters. The current add-ons card design has no visible CTA, but the value is still passed to the runtime for consistency.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Buy Label
params.description: Localized buy label available to dynamic adapters for numeric add-on pricing.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Contact Label
params.description: Label shown in place of price when Core PIM marks an add-on as custom or negotiated.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Error Mode
params.description: Failure behavior for dynamic loading. Current supported behavior keeps the static CMS fallback and records data-pricing-error on the section.

params.name: Collapse Section
params.description: When 'on', the header becomes a teaser band and the whole card grid collapses behind a toggle (requires JS; without it every card stays visible). Works at any card count.

params.name: Summary Add-ons Label
params.description: Localized label used by JS in the generated collapsed summary after the add-on count.

params.name: Summary Categories Label
params.description: Localized label used by JS in the generated collapsed summary after the category count.

params.name: Summary From Label
params.description: Localized prefix used by JS before the lowest numeric add-on price in the generated collapsed summary.

params.name: Expand Label
params.description: Band toggle label shown while the section is collapsed.

params.name: Collapse Label
params.description: Band toggle label shown while the section is expanded.

notes: Dynamic mode is not limited by the fallback slot count; it renders every product returned by the configured Core PIM catalog specs.
pricing_catalog_specs can request multiple product types with different price filters. The production format leaves fixtureUrl empty.
Static add-on slots remain in the template only for editor preview and failure fallback.
